snippet.title: TrueWorld Games - UNYIELDER Launch Trailer (Sep 2025)
snippet.description:
PRETENDERS, the moment has arrived - UNYIELDER is OUT NOW!
Steam: https://bit.ly/uny_steam_yt
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/unyielder-175ec8

The frozen wasteland of post-apocalyptic Antarctica is ready for your fury. UNYIELDER—the relentless boss-rush roguelike FPS that merges bullet-hell chaos with lightning-fast movement—is officially available now.

Step into the ruins of EREBUS and carve your path through machine-gods and towering derelicts. Wield volatile weapons, unleash game-breaking skills, and grow stronger with each fallen enemy in this unforgiving world where hesitation means death.

Experience the spectacular, absurd, and chaotic encounters that define UNYIELDER. Break the game. Embody tenacity. Build your own final boss from the limbs of your enemies.

■ UNYIELDER Official Discord
https://discord.gg/gTngE4hdT9

■ UNYIELDER Official Website
https://shueisha-games.com/games/unyielder/

■ UNYIELDER Official Twitter/X
https://x.com/PlayUNYIELDER

Genre: Roguelike x High-Speed x Boss Rush FPS
Platforms: Steam® / Epic Games Store

Developer: TrueWorld Studios
©TrueWorld Studios Pte. Ltd. / SHUEISHA, SHUEISHA GAMES

#UNYIELDER #IndieGame #Roguelite #FPS #BossRush
